api_errors.source: provider failures inside seat transcripts; the file's last write is the minute the failure was reported

box_memory_queue.source: thor-admit daemon.sample (UTC in the log, converted to local)

client_lost.note: a proxy for 'the provider call died': quota exhaustion and network timeouts look the same from the box's side, and so does a seat that simply finished, so it is noisy
client_lost.source: thor-admit lease.client_gone / lease.waiter_client_gone: an API client disappeared while holding (or waiting for) a lease

disk_free.gap: no disk sample exists before the board loop started at 14:58:57 and none after 15:40:15; there is no other disk sampler on either box
disk_free.source: board-history 'Thor disk: NG free' (board.sh runs df -h /)

seat_commit.source: git log in each seat's worktree; commit times are exact

seat_output.assumption: a seat is taken to be producing output until its last write; silence before that write is not recoverable from the artefacts
seat_output.source: seat .out mtime (the board's out age is exactly now - mtime; validated)

wifi_aborts.source: Thor journal _cmd_abort_notify abort=1, bucketed per minute

notes: The board's own 'out age (min)' column equals (snapshot time - .out mtime) for every seat in every snapshot; the reconstruction reproduces it.
